data.name: Little Magic Fish Story
data.detailed_description:
Little Magic Fish Story is a pixel-art life sim and party-based action RPG. Crops you grow, meals you cook, fish you catch, and animal products you collect become supplies for the next expedition. Materials and equipment recovered from dungeons help your farm, skills, and party grow in return.

Live your days in Anyu Town

Till, sow, water, and harvest. Lay out barns and cooking stations, then turn each season's bounty into meals, quest items, and expedition supplies. Seasons, weather, and elemental changes you trigger affect crops, animals, gathering spots, and fishing waters. Life skills improve through use, while surplus goods earn the gold needed to expand the life you are building.

Command companions with distinct roles

Take quests from the Adventurers' Guild and fight alongside five companions. Queue movement, attack-move, and skill commands for individual party members as weak-point breaks, floating blade arrays, mana cycles, and dedicated support reshape each encounter.

Forge your own playstyle

Customize your character's appearance and history, then mix and match skills freely. Chain rapid melee attacks, unleash spells from afar, or find your own balance between offense and defense. Deepening bonds with townsfolk and companions unlocks skills they can teach, while gear affixes, skill specializations, and set bonuses shape a build of your own.

An adventure under your command

Direct your party with command-queue micro: kite, attack-move, and issue orders unit by unit. After the story is cleared, your companions will even organize dungeon runs on their own, gearing up from the Shared Chest to grow stronger — and you can join them anytime.

The seasons turn, and each brings its own harvest.

Different waters hide different fish. Weather can trigger Elemental Activation and push your yields beyond expectations.

A mystery in the Silent Forest

Life in Anyu Town is warm and busy, but a scorched device fragment whose serial number was deliberately erased proves that the disturbance in the Silent Forest is no ordinary monster outbreak. As the investigation deepens, the Little Magic Fish Adventurers follow a trail left by Sandao Tech, while each companion must weigh the so-called optimal choice against the reasons that truly matter to them.

Current Demo Content

- Several hours of main story content covering farming, shipping, cooking, fishing, and triggering elemental changes in the environment.

- Animal raising and the Boss Gauntlet as optional activities.

- Life skills that improve through use and can reach level 10.

- Affection and gift-giving, including the first two tiers of skills taught by NPCs.

- An Adventurers' Guild quest board with hunt and collection quests.

- Five Silent Forest dungeons, each culminating in a boss battle.

- First-clear equipment, random drops, set bonuses, and special gear affixes.

- All five adventurers introduced, with their daily lives and expeditions continuing after the Demo story.

Bring your daily life into adventure, and bring adventure home.
Add the game to your wishlist and play the Demo.

data.short_description: Little Magic Fish Story is a pixel-art life sim and party-based action RPG. Farm, cook, fish, and raise animals in Anyu Town. Turn harvests into supplies and command companions in the Silent Forest. Amid warm days and strange disturbances, the adventurers' story begins.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 510 / AMD Radeon R5 Graphics or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 64-bit processor and operating system required. Vulkan 1.0 or Direct3D 12 (Feature Level 12_0) compatible GPU required.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 / AMD Radeon RX 460 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Vulkan 1.2 or Direct3D 12 compatible GPU recommended.
